title: Akil writes the next word before it is written (crossed-out word test)

tellings.quote: it out the second it's crossed out and you start even thinking about the next one he'd start writing the next one

plain: The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about nonspeaking children said to read minds, says she watched a boy named Akil in New Jersey in 2023 write words before anyone showed them to him. She says she saw it herself: as soon as a word on a list was crossed out and someone started thinking about the next one, Akil would start writing it, with a woman named Manisha also part of the test. If true, it would point to the boy picking up thoughts directly.
